title: World BEYOND War Africa chapter and public-person expansion

sources.title: World BEYOND War Who We Are

summary: Expanded the existing World BEYOND War seed into five current first-party-listed African chapters and explicit public organizer/founder roles for Guy Feugap.

provenance.method: bounded current first-party chapter expansion with repository deduplication

classification_rules: Treat first-party regional chapter listings as explicit local_chapter_of evidence.
Preserve every named chapter as a distinct organization.
Treat Guy Feugap founder and organizer roles as explicit first-party public roles.
data.method: Follow the unresolved World BEYOND War chapter-network edge from the Syracuse peace-network pass; enumerate a bounded current first-party Africa chapter slice; deduplicate names against repository search; cross-enumerate the explicit public Africa organizer/founder role; preserve all chapter nodes separately.
data.narrative_role: bounded chapter/affiliate and public-person expansion investigator
data.research_question: Which current World BEYOND War African chapters and public organizer roles can be materialized from first-party structure pages?

findings.finding: World BEYOND War's current Africa page explicitly lists Burundi, Senegal, Cameroon, Nigeria and Mali chapters.
The same current first-party Africa page identifies Guy Feugap as World BEYOND War's Africa Organizer and states that he founded the Cameroon chapter in 2020.
